For hanging strips like Command strips, pull slowly, straight down and parallel to the wall, stretching the strip along its length until it releases, and warm it with a hairdryer for 20 to 30 seconds or saw behind it with dental floss if it resists. If these are wound-closure strips (Steri-Strips) on healing skin, don't pull them off early: let them fall off on their own, usually within 7 to 10 days, and check with a clinician if the wound reopens or isn't healing. I'm not sure which kind you mean, so the answer depends on that.

CONFIDENCE: 70
